record.what_it_does: Google's AI research notebook; Enterprise edition has a preview API for notebooks via Discovery Engine.
record.auth_notes: Docs show a Google user access token (gcloud auth print-access-token). The user needs a Gemini Notebook Enterprise license and the roles/discoveryengine.notebookLmUser IAM role. This is Google OAuth2 user credentials on Google Cloud. It is not a service-account flow, and I didn't confirm one is supported.
record.access_notes: Calls require an authenticated user with an active Gemini Notebook Enterprise license. It is sold standalone or as part of Gemini Enterprise. I didn't confirm exact NotebookLM Enterprise pricing. The API is marked Preview (pre-GA). The consumer NotebookLM has no public API.
record.api_breadth_notes: Notebooks: create, get, listRecentlyViewed, batchDelete, share. Sources are on a separate page that I didn't open. The Notebooks page doesn't mention audio overviews. Endpoint is discoveryengine.googleapis.com v1alpha.
record.mcp_notes: Only third-party servers turned up, e.g. pleaseprompto/notebooklm-mcp and PyPI notebooklm-mcp-server. These are unofficial and mostly drive the consumer web app. I found no Google-official server.
record.blocker_notes: Needs a paid Gemini Notebook Enterprise license per user, the API is v1alpha/Preview, and the notebook-management surface is small. Customers would have to be on Google Cloud with Gemini Enterprise. Consumer NotebookLM has no API.
